info.title: Knightfall Between the Flames AI Bridge
info.description: Private account-scoped Knightfall shared task and handoff note API. Each authorized collaborator creates a separate expiring AI key at https://ash-fall.com/ai-handoff.html. Never put keys in GPT instructions, chat messages or a public GPT. Read the latest snapshot before making updates.

KnightfallBridgeKey.description: Use the private one-time key generated under Between the Flames -> AI connections. Enter only in the GPT Action authentication settings.

version.description: Exact current version from getHandoffSnapshot. A stale version returns 409.

get.summary: Read the latest shared Knightfall to-do list and handoff notes
get.description: Read the current task list, versions and private handoff notes before working on the shared project. Previous chat messages may be outdated.

200.description: Authenticated shared workspace response with current records.

401.description: Missing, expired, or revoked connection key.

403.description: The account no longer has permission to collaborate.

409.description: Task changed; fetch a new snapshot for its current version.

post.summary: Add a shared Knightfall to-do item
post.description: Create a task in the same live workspace visible to Ronnie and Samantha. Only use for a task explicitly requested in the ongoing conversation. Confirm the returned result before claiming completion.

patch.summary: Update a shared task status or details
patch.description: First read getHandoffSnapshot to obtain the current version. Never mark a task complete without verified evidence. Pass the exact version in request body. On 409 refresh the snapshot and reconcile, do not overwrite another person's changes.

post.description: After significant verified updates, decisions, or blockers, leave a concise dated note in the live shared board. Avoid sensitive unrelated personal data. Confirm the successful API response.
